title: mentha viridis var. malinvaldii
intro: Mentha viridis var. malinvaldii, commonly known as a variant of spearmint, is a plant species within the mint family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to ease digestive issues, reduce nausea, and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Mentha viridis var. malinvaldii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as menthone, limonene, and menthol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
